summary: Brera Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K reporting the adoption of a shareholder rights plan (poison pill) via a Rights Agreement with Equiniti Trust Company as rights agent. The plan authorizes one purchase right per Class B ordinary share, issued to shareholders of record on May 5, 2026, expiring April 23, 2027. Rights become exercisable if a person acquires 9.99% (20% for 13G investors) without board approval, causing significant dilution. The board adopted the plan to protect long-term shareholder value, not in response to any specific takeover proposal. There are no deal terms disclosed; this is a defensive measure. Watch for any future acquisition approach triggering the pill.
